rule: Work on one feature at a time. A feature moves to passing only when its verification command succeeds. Verification commands are proposals; finalise each one before starting the feature.

features.behavior: Pinned Nix toolchain, api/ crates/retake_render/ web/ skeletons each with one passing test, justfile (setup, dev, test, check, render), boundary check, CI running check + test, PROGRESS.md.
features.verification: just check && just test && just check-boundaries

features.behavior: Load a spec JSON, validate it against spec/video.schema.json and the semantic rules in spec/SPEC.md; return all errors with JSON paths.
A fixtures/media folder with a few small CC0 images, one short video clip, a voice-over WAV and a music track, plus fixture specs that reference them with correct content hashes.

Rust CLI loads a spec (accepting and rejecting the same spec/examples as F01) and renders image and video scenes, cover fit, Ken Burns motion, video trim and cuts to a 1080x1920 MP4 of the right duration. Settles: video clip shorter than its scene (loop, freeze or reject).
features.verification: cargo test -p retake_render spec basic && just render fixtures/specs/minimal.json && just probe-check

features.behavior: Crossfade and fade-through-black transitions; text overlays; captions in phrase and word_highlight modes driven by word timings. Settles: bundled fonts as hashed assets.
Mix voice-overs with offsets, music with fades and ducking under voice, and a final loudness pass to the spec target. Settles: loudness pass in Rust or FFmpeg loudnorm.
Rendering the same spec and assets twice produces byte-identical MP4s (D12 scope); asset content_hash is checked before use.
Elixir runs the renderer as a Port, streams progress lines, and returns the output path or a structured error.
Load config/providers.toml, select a profile, resolve providers with fallbacks, read keys from env, enforce rate limits and budget caps.
Retake.Storage (local disk) stores assets by content hash; the request cache returns an existing asset for a repeated request_hash without calling the provider.
features.verification: cd api && mix test test/retake/storage_test.exs test/retake/cache_test.exs

features.behavior: LLM turns a brief into a title and scene intents (narration, visual_query, optional on-screen text) using structured output, validated and retried on bad JSON.
For each scene, search stock (Pexels) for portrait video or photo, pick the best fit, store it with licence and attribution.
TTS each scene's narration, then transcribe it to word timings; set scene durations from voice-over length plus padding.

Prompt in, valid spec and MP4 out. Steps per scene run in parallel; progress events are broadcast; failures report which step and scene. Includes the videos/jobs table (Postgres), POST /api/videos, GET /api/videos/:id and media file serving, and the music pick from a CC0 library with manifest. Plan mode first.
Web page with a prompt box, live step-by-step progress over a Channel, a video player and a download link.
features.verification: cd web && npm test && just e2e-smoke

features.behavior: 10 varied prompts each produce a watchable video with no manual fixes, using the free profile.
features.verification: just acceptance  # runs the 10 prompts, then manual review checklist in docs/ACCEPTANCE.md
